messages:
anya: Quick sync  planning a 6-week PLG funnel experiment around the webinar + benchmark post. Goal: +20% first-week activation using free credits + onboarding nudges. Thoughts?
sam: Love it. Can we A/B test credit sizes? Suggest $50 vs $150 equivalent in tokens. Keep one arm with a small credit + tailored prompt templates.
luke: Agree on sizing. Add a control group with no credits but extra onboarding emails. Metrics: activation@48h, 7-day retention, avg tokens first 7 days.
maria: I'll own webinar landing page & registration flow. Route registrants to inbound funnel: auto-create SF leads when usage >1k tokens in 24h OR on demo request. Small teams -> SDR queue; enterprise domains -> AE.
anya: Need a webhook spec for routing. ops-bot: New endpoint /hooks/lead-route expects payload: {"email":"..", "company":"..", "tokens_used":1234, "signed_up_at":".."}. Docs updated.
sam: Draft launch messaging variants:
- Variant A (benchmark angle): "Redwood Inference: predictable latency + 2-5x lower per-token cost. New benchmark + config guide."
- Variant B (PLG hook): "Try Redwood free  $150 in credits + prompt templates to ship faster. Webinar: cutting inference costs."
luke: Social copy (short): "Built for production LLMs  predictable latency + cost controls. Join our webinar + grab free credits: <link>" (under 200 chars).
maria: Webinar format: 20m demo (console + templates), 20m best practices (benchmarks + cost controls), 10m Q&A + routing promo, CTA with one-click credits. Speakers: anya (product), luke (runtime), sam (growth).
anya: Emphasize prompt templates + caching reduced token usage for sample app. Show before/after cost per 1k requests.
sam: Email subject tests:
- A: "Youre invited: Cut LLM inference costs  webinar + $150 credit"
- B: "Free credits inside  learn how to run LLMs reliably at scale"
- C: "Benchmark + quickstart: Redwood Inference webinar"
luke: Onboarding nudges (proposed): 1) Immediate: surface 3 templated prompts in dashboard (chat, summarize, classify). 2) 6hr email: "Try these prompts to see response patterns". 3) 24hr push: reward extra $25 credit if >2k tokens used.
maria: Add UTM on reg link: ?utm_source=webinar_apr2024&utm_campaign=end_of_q2. Instrument cohort analysis by signup_source (webinar, blog, organic).
anya: Experiment arms:
- Arm 1: $150 credit + templates + nudges
- Arm 2: $50 credit + templates + nudges
- Arm 3: No credit + aggressive onboarding emails
- Control: baseline onboarding
Measure: activation@48h, conversion@30d, avg token spend@7d.
sam: Need analytics ownership. @luke? Shared sheet + Looker dashboard. Also funnel email copy per arm.
luke: Ill spin up dashboards and add SQL for activation: SELECT * FROM events WHERE name='first_active' AND props->>'tokens'>'0'. Sheet placeholder: https://app.example.com/sheets/plg-webinar-experiment.
maria: Routing rules (v1): enterprise domain OR company_size>250 -> AE queue; tokens_used>5k within 3 days -> SDR+AE alert (hot lead); else -> self-serve drip + weekly tips.
anya: Add benchmark narrative for blog: highlight chat, summarization, embeddings with latency & cost table; call out batching + KV caching gains vs naive hosting. Keep it technical but readable.
sam: Blog CTA: "Get $150 free credits + production templates — sign up" linking to webinar & one-click credits.
luke: Ops: set quota guardrails to prevent abuse. Cap $300/org lifetime for experiment.
maria: Timeline: This week finalize copy & reg page; next week A/B ads + save-the-date; two weeks webinar + emails live; post-webinar 7-day activation analysis.
anya: Volunteers to draft benchmark blurb? 3 paragraphs + 1 table.
sam: I can draft by EOD Friday.
luke: Ill validate numbers + add charts.
anya: Owners: sam(copy & launch posts), maria(landing & routing), luke(analytics & infra), anya(experiment design & blog). Sync Thurs 10am. :thumbsup:
maria: Calendar event added. ops-bot: automation lead_routing_v1 enabled in staging; monitor /ops/lead-route/logs.
anya: Thanks team, excited to roll this out.
